description: This file is a Perl module that provides a wrapper for loading CPAN modules, with fallback mechanisms and environment-based configurations. It defines constants, a subroutine 'import', and documentation explaining its purpose within the Git project.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles loading a specified Perl module, with fallback to loading from the 'FromCPAN' directory if not found, based on environment variables. Also manages symbol exporting for callers.
